messages:
Samir (sales): Heads-up — ACME Health (EU) sent a security/compliance questionnaire. They want SOC2 controls, HIPAA attestation for PHI handling, GDPR DSRs, audit log retention requirements (they mentioned 7 years), and our data retention/deletion policy. They asked for a reply in 5 business days. Can we triage and assign owner + ETA? cc @Lucy @Mia

Lucy (product): @Samir thanks — do we have an up-to-date SOC2 artifact we can share? Also need to confirm whether they expect hosted or Dedicated/private deployment; HIPAA likely requires BAA + Dedicated.

Mia (security): We have a SOC2 Type II report (audit completed 2024-11) — available under NDA. HIPAA: we support BAA and recommend Dedicated/Private for PHI. GDPR: DPA exists, will link. Audit logs: hosted retention defaults are shorter (logs 90d, token/embedding logs 30d). Dedicated/Private can be configured for longer retention. Need clarification if 7 years is mandatory or a preference.

Jordan (product): This reads like an enterprise intake. Proposed next steps: 1) Confirm deployment expectation with sales. 2) Provide redacted SOC2 + BAA/DPA links. 3) Provide controls mapping + sample audit log schema. 4) Clarify retention options (hosted vs Dedicated) and propose paid add-on for extended retention. Someone create intake ticket and assign to product + compliance.

Samir (sales): I'll ask ACME which deployment they plan to use and whether 7 years is non-negotiable. Can someone spin up the intake ticket and a one‑pager for the customer reply?

Lucy (product): I'll create the ticket and draft the initial reply. @Mia can you attach SOC2 artifact (redacted) and the BAA/DPA links? Also need exact hosted retention numbers and the config key for Dedicated (so I can include them in the answer).

Mia (security): Hosted: audit logs retention = 90 days, token/embedding logs = 30 days. Dedicated/private: configurable via `retention_days` in infra config and we can support longer retention subject to storage costs and legal signoff. We keep only payload hashes in hosted (no raw request bodies) — note for HIPAA this matters. I'll attach a sample controls mapping and recommended SLA language.

jira-bot: Created ticket PRD-4829 "Customer intake: ACME Health compliance questionnaire" assigned to @Lucy

Lucy (product): PRD-4829 created. ETA for initial response: Tue COB (48 hrs after sales confirms deployment). Marking as high-priority enterprise request; adding to Q3 roadmap candidates. @Jordan can you scope engineering effort for offering >1yr retention on Dedicated?

Jordan (product): Rough scope: backend retention config + long-term storage policy, small admin UI for retention settings, and updates to ingestion pipeline to support cold storage lifecycle. Estimate: ~2 sprints (4 wks) dev + 1 wk for infra ops + legal review. Recommend offering this as a paid add-on initially to cover storage costs. Risk: storage growth and performance for long-tail queries.

Mia (security): Compliance notes: BAA template is ready. For HIPAA attestation we need Dedicated/private deployments with agreed controls; hosted customers cannot be certified for HIPAA without Private per our current policy. For GDPR DSRs, we have a runbook and can provide DPA; I'll produce a controls mapping doc mapping SOC2 controls -> our implementation.

Samir (sales): ACME asked whether we can share a redacted SOC2 report immediately and if our audit logs include fields regulators commonly request (user id, IP, request payload hash).

Lucy (product): We'll share a redacted SOC2 report under NDA and include a controls mapping + log schema. @Mia can you confirm the exact log fields we retain and what can be redacted?

Mia (security): Confirmed fields: timestamp, user_id, request_id, model, token_count, source_ip (can be redacted on request or provided in Dedicated), and a SHA256 hash of payloads. Hosted does not store raw request bodies; only hashes for traceability. I'll add the schema to the controls doc and include notes about redaction and retention.

Samir (sales): Perfect — I'll loop ACME in with PRD-4829 link and the initial one-pager once Lucy has it. Any blockers?

Jordan (product): Blocker: hosted infra currently not sized for multi-year retention at scale. Ops needs to approve if we try to extend hosted retention beyond current defaults. Plan: Offer multi-year retention only on Dedicated/Private for now.

Lucy (product): Deliverables for the customer reply: 1) redacted SOC2, 2) BAA + DPA links, 3) controls mapping doc + log schema, 4) recommended deployment and retention options (hosted default vs Dedicated/paid add-on). Target: Tue COB. :thumbsup:

Mia (security): I'll attach the SOC2 redacted snapshot and BAA/DPA drafts to PRD-4829 and start the controls mapping doc.

Samir (sales): Thanks everyone. I'll update ACME after Lucy posts the one-pager.

Lucy (product): Closing out here — assigned actions in PRD-4829. Will follow up if ACME confirms 7yr requirement or asks for on‑prem. :eyes:
